instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: fast travel ruins open worlds.

Red Dead 2 makes you ride, and those long rides are where the best moments happen. Morrowind had no map-click travel. Silt striders and written directions made the world feel real. With fast travel, most Skyrim players skip the world they paid for. Agree?
